details:
would like to request adding Bunny.net CDN support to the VRChat video player URL whitelist.

Requested domains:

*.bunny.net

*.b-cdn.net

*.bunnycdn.com

Bunny.net is a reliable CDN and video hosting platform that could provide VRChat world creators with a stable option for hosting video and music content for worlds, clubs, events, and community spaces.

Adding Bunny.net support would help solve several problems creators currently face:

More reliable playback by using a dedicated CDN designed for content delivery.

Better worldwide performance by serving content from servers closer to users.

More creator control over playlists and hosted content without needing to constantly change broken links.

Reduced issues caused by external services changing policies, removing content, adding restrictions, or affecting playback.

Easier management of large music/event systems because creators could update hosted content without needing to rebuild or reupload worlds.

Many VRChat worlds rely on video players for atmosphere, entertainment, music, clubs, events, and interactive experiences. Having another reliable hosting option would benefit both creators and the communities who visit these worlds.
title: Whitelist for your domains to the VRChat video player
